rules.description: block self-identifying AI agents on the two legal pages that name the operator (ADR-028, ADR-030)
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/legal/imprint" or http.request.uri.path eq "/legal/imprint/" or http.request.uri.path eq "/legal/privacy" or http.request.uri.path eq "/legal/privacy/") and (http.user_agent contains "GPTBot" or http.user_agent contains "OAI-SearchBot" or http.user_agent contains "ChatGPT-User" or http.user_agent contains "OAI-AdsBot" or http.user_agent contains "ClaudeBot" or http.user_agent contains "Claude-User" or http.user_agent contains "Claude-SearchBot")
